name: Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka
summary: Wellington university with six faculties, Law and Business in the parliamentary precinct, and one entry rule for every bachelor's degree.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma with 24 points minimum, any maths, and English Language A (SL or HL) or Language B HL. Every bachelor's degree shares this entry rule; some add an audition or other requirement.

apply.via: Victoria University of Wellington online application

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws
programmes.about: A four-year law degree from the Faculty of Law, which sits in Wellington's parliamentary precinct. First-year law courses are open to everyone with University Entrance; entry to second-year Law is limited and ranked on first-year grades.
programmes.selectionNote: First year (LAWS 121) is open with University Entrance, room permitting; second-year places are ranked on your law grade point average, with a 1 December application.

flagshipSource.title: Victoria news: law expertise tops New Zealand in the THE 2026 subject rankings

programmes.name: Political Science and International Relations
programmes.about: Study how power and resources are distributed and how political decisions shape societies, in New Zealand's capital. Political Science here came first in the country, and it is the only undergraduate International Relations degree.
programmes.selectionNote: No degree-specific selection is published: the shared bachelor's entry rule applies, a full IB Diploma with 24 points and the English and maths conditions.

flagshipSource.title: Victoria Political Science and International Relations: the only undergraduate IR degree in New Zealand

faculties.name: Faculty of Architecture and Design Innovation
faculties.line: Same bachelor's entry rule as everywhere; 2027 international fees are NZ$44,399 (Design) and NZ$47,137 (Architecture) for an average year.

faculties.name: Wellington School of Business and Government
faculties.line: Same bachelor's entry rule as everywhere; the 2027 international Commerce fee is NZ$39,798 for an average year.

faculties.name: Faculty of Education, Health, and Psychological Sciences
faculties.line: Bachelor of Education (Teaching) Early Childhood and Midwifery need IELTS 7.0, not the standard 6.0.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Same bachelor's entry rule; performing degrees may add an audition; the 2027 Humanities fee is NZ$37,483 for an average year.

faculties.name: Faculty of Law
faculties.line: First-year law is open with University Entrance; second-year Law is limited and ranked on first-year law grades.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Engineering
faculties.line: Same bachelor's entry rule as everywhere; 2027 international fees are NZ$42,892 (Science) and NZ$49,237 (Engineering) for an average year.

notes: EU citizens pay the international fee; Victoria's 2027 table gives the cost of an average year of 120 points, GST included, for each subject area.
The standard English requirement is IELTS Academic 6.0 with no band below 5.5; the IB page accepts English Language A at SL or HL, or Language B HL, as the University Entrance literacy requirement.
You can ask your school to give the university electronic access to your IB results once they are released, which speeds up assessment.
